name: Scene-dependent tools across game states
description: Probes the scene-dependent tools in a level, while a level loads, at the main menu, on the world map and at a finished level. While a level loads and on the world map player 0 is still playing with no Player of its own, so it is listed as joined. From the main menu it also presses fire through Start, Continue Campaign, the save slot and Play Offline to the join screen, where it reads game_state, a fire joins player 0 on controller 4 and it reads game_state and inspect_player again, the slot being listed as joined, then returns to the main menu so the next level load puts player 0 back on controller 0. Loading is reached by a go_to_level with no wait and a check that the LoadingScreen scene is up, and the world map by loading it and probing within the second or so campaign 0 stays there before it moves on to the next briefing; game speed 0 cannot hold it, since freezing the game while the world map loads crashed it. Both are races fixed waits cannot remove: a precondition step that fails is a timing miss, not a tool fault. The finished level is held with game speed 0 and its outcome held off, so finishing it writes nothing to the save, and the last step checks the territory's start level is the one the run found. Needs campaign 0 and Swap Bros Mod. Its first step presses escape until a frame reads it, so a run started during the loading screen waits that out; the next steps undo whatever an earlier run left changed and wait until the scene has stood unchanged for 4 s, outside the loading screen and, in a level, with the level built and not moving on, so a run started during a load, or from the world map as it moves on, records the level the game settles in; its last steps restore the speed and the Swap Bros selection and reload the level it started in. Its cleanup runs the restore again whatever ended the steps: pause, speed, the second player, IronBro, the lock and the Swap Bros selection.
